release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.7 Horizontal Category Navigation, Small-Screen Responsive Layout & WinUI 3 Dark Mode:
• Top Horizontal Category Navigation: Replaced nested inner sidebar with sleek horizontal category pills (All, Chairs, Strands, CAD, Schedules, QA, System), restoring a clean, full-width settings interface without duplicate sidebars.
• Small-Screen & Laptop Responsive Viewport: Reclaimed 248px of width, ensuring all numeric inputs, dropdowns, and buttons remain 100% visible and unclipped across all screen sizes.
• Windows 11 HDR Display Support: When HDR is active, seamlessly applies authentic WinUI 3 solid dark mode (#202020) with elevated cards (#2B2B2B), eliminating the empty pitch-black background void caused by GDI scRGB swapchain keying.
• Instant Search & Section Jump: Quick keyword search filter and smooth category scrolling.
